First normalized official-source review. The rules establish 70/20, levels 1–11 and one round every day. The published 19:35 value is when the draw recording is available, so no exact local draw time or IANA timezone was inferred. Kung Keno is an add-on, not a separate offering; the SEK 40,000,000 maximum is conditional on level 11, Kung Keno and a SEK 10 stake. Svenska Spel claims copyright over site content and no redistribution licence was found, so only factual assertions and source links are recorded.
